WHO GLAAS Dataset

Source: R/glaas.R
glaas.Rd

The complete dataset from the UN-Water Global Analysis and Assessment of Sanitation and Drinking-water (GLAAS).

Usage

glaas

Format

A tibble with 259546 rows and 121 variables

feature_id

Numeric identifier of the record in the WHO source table (source column FID). Each of the 259,546 rows has its own value.

language

Language of the text columns. Every row holds "EN" for English.

parent_location_type

Type of the region that the country is grouped under. Every row holds "WHO Region".

parent_location_type_name

Display name of the region type. Every row holds "WHO Region".

parent_loc_type_seq

Sort order number from the WHO source table (source column ParentLocTypeSeq). In this dataset it holds the same value as parent_loc_seq, 1 to 6.

parent_location_code

Code of the WHO region of the country: AFR, AMR, EMR, EUR, SEAR or WPR.

parent_location_name

Name of the WHO region of the country, for example "African Region".

parent_loc_seq

Sort order number of the WHO region, 1 to 6.

region_sdg_code

Code of the Sustainable Development Goal (SDG) region of the country, for example "SDG_SSA".

region_sdg_name

Name of the SDG region of the country, for example "Sub-Saharan Africa".

parent_loc_seq_sdg

Sort order number of the SDG region.

region_world_bank_code

Code of the World Bank income group of the country: LIC, LMC, UMC or HIC. Missing for Anguilla, Cook Islands and Venezuela (Bolivarian Republic of).

region_world_bank_name

Name of the World Bank income group of the country: "Low income", "Lower middle income", "Upper middle income" or "High income".

parent_loc_seq_wbig

Sort order number of the World Bank income group, from 1 for low income to 4 for high income.

region_unicef_reporting_code

Code of the UNICEF reporting region of the country, for example "SSA".

region_unicef_reporting_name

Name of the UNICEF reporting region of the country, for example "Sub-Saharan Africa".

parent_loc_seq_unice_frept

Sort order number from the WHO source table (source column ParentLocSeq_UNICEFrept). In this dataset it holds the same value as loc_seq, one number per country.

region_unicef_program_code

Code of the UNICEF programme region of the country, for example "ESA". Missing for 12 countries.

region_unicef_program_name

Name of the UNICEF programme region of the country, for example "Eastern and Southern Africa". Missing for 12 countries.

parent_loc_seq_unice_fprgm

Sort order number from the WHO source table (source column ParentLocSeq_UNICEFprgm). In this dataset it holds the same value as loc_seq, one number per country.

grand_parent

Code of the thematic area of the indicator: EQUITY, FINANCE, GOV, HUMRES or MONITOR.

grand_parent_text

Name of the thematic area of the indicator: "Equity", "Finance", "Governance", "Human resources" or "Monitoring".

grand_parent_seq

Sort order number of the thematic area, 1 to 5.

parent

Code of the topic that the indicator belongs to within its thematic area, for example "BUDGET".

parent_text

Name of the topic that the indicator belongs to, for example "Budgets".

parent_seq

Sort order number of the topic within its thematic area.

indicator_code

Code of the indicator, for example "ABSORB_DOM". The dataset holds 333 indicators.

indicator_prefix

Reference label of the indicator, written in square brackets, for example FIN08 for a finance indicator.

indicator_name

Full name of the indicator, starting with its reference label.

indicator_name_highlight

Name of the indicator without the reference label (source column IndText_HL). For some indicators the wording is shorter than in indicator_name.

ind_seq

Sort order number of the indicator.

country_type

Type of the location: "Member State" or "Territory or Area".

country_type_name

Display name of the location type: "Countries, territories and areas" or "Territory or Area".

loc_type_seq

Sort order number of the location type: 4 for Member State, 6 for Territory or Area.

country_code

Three letter ISO 3166-1 code of the country, territory or area, for example "AFG".

country_name

Name of the country, territory or area. The dataset holds 151 of them.

loc_seq

Sort order number of the country, territory or area.

time_type

Type of the time period. Every row holds "YEAR".

time_type_name

Display name of the type of time period. Every row holds "Year".

time_type_seq

Sort order number of the type of time period. Every row holds 1.

time_period

Year that names the GLAAS survey cycle the record comes from: 2013, 2016, 2018, 2021 or 2024.

time_seq

Sort order number of the survey cycle. Newer cycles have lower numbers, from 17 for 2024 to 28 for 2013.

data_year

Year that the value refers to. It equals time_period in most rows and differs where a country gave another year, such as a baseline year, a target year or a financial year (1987 to 2050).

published

Whether the record is published. Every row holds TRUE.

status

Status of the record in the WHO source table. Empty in every row.

published_country_highlights

Flag from the WHO source table (source column Published_CH). The name suggests that it marks whether the record is published in the GLAAS country highlights.

is_comparable

General comparability flag from the WHO source table. Empty in every row.

is_comparable_2013

Flag from the WHO source table (source column IsComparable_2013). The name suggests that it marks whether the record can be compared with the 2013 survey cycle.

is_comparable_2016

Flag from the WHO source table (source column IsComparable_2016). The name suggests that it marks whether the record can be compared with the 2016 survey cycle.

is_comparable_2018

Flag from the WHO source table (source column IsComparable_2018). The name suggests that it marks whether the record can be compared with the 2018 survey cycle.

is_comparable_2021

Flag from the WHO source table (source column IsComparable_2021). The name suggests that it marks whether the record can be compared with the 2021 survey cycle.

is_comparable_2024

Flag from the WHO source table (source column IsComparable_2024). The name suggests that it marks whether the record can be compared with the 2024 survey cycle.

is_latest

TRUE for the record from the most recent survey cycle in which the country has a value for this indicator and this combination of dimensions.

dimension1_type

Code of the first breakdown of the indicator. Every row holds "SERVICES".

dimension1_type_name

Name of the first breakdown of the indicator. Every row holds "Service".

dim1type_seq

Sort order number of the type of the first breakdown. Every row holds 3.

dimension1_value

Code of the service that the record refers to, for example "SAN", "WATER_DRNK", "HYG" or "WASH".

dimension1_value_name

Name of the service that the record refers to, for example "Sanitation", "Drinking-water", "Hygiene" or "WASH".

dim1val_seq

Sort order number of the service.

dimension2_type

Code of the second breakdown of the indicator: "SETTINGS" or "SUBSERVICES".

dimension2_type_name

Name of the second breakdown of the indicator: "Setting" or "Sub-service".

dim2type_seq

Sort order number of the type of the second breakdown: 2 for Setting, 4 for Sub-service.

dimension2_value

Code of the setting or sub-service that the record refers to, for example "RUR", "URB" or "NAT".

dimension2_value_name

Name of the setting or sub-service that the record refers to, for example "Rural", "Urban" or "National*". The GLAAS data portal notes that "national" refers to countries, territories and areas.

dim2val_seq

Sort order number of the setting or sub-service. Missing in 105 rows.

dimension3_type

Code of the third breakdown of the indicator, for example "SETTINGS", "ACTIONS" or "DOCUMENTS". Missing where the record has no third breakdown.

dimension3_type_name

Name of the third breakdown of the indicator, for example "Setting", "Actions" or "Document". Missing where the record has no third breakdown.

dim3type_seq

Sort order number of the type of the third breakdown.

dimension3_value

Code of the category of the third breakdown that the record refers to, for example "NAT".

dimension3_value_name

Name of the category of the third breakdown that the record refers to, for example "National*".

dim3val_seq

Sort order number of the category of the third breakdown.

dimension4_type

Code of the fourth breakdown of the indicator: "ACTIONS", "DETAIL" or "DOCUMENTS". Missing where the record has no fourth breakdown.

dimension4_type_name

Name of the fourth breakdown of the indicator: "Actions", "Details" or "Document". Missing where the record has no fourth breakdown.

dim4type_seq

Sort order number of the type of the fourth breakdown.

dimension4_value

Code of the category of the fourth breakdown that the record refers to, for example "STDS_REGS".

dimension4_value_name

Name of the category of the fourth breakdown that the record refers to, for example "Standards or regulations".

dim4val_seq

Sort order number of the category of the fourth breakdown.

dimension5_type

Code of the fifth breakdown of the indicator: "DETAIL" or "ACTIONS". Missing where the record has no fifth breakdown.

dimension5_type_name

Name of the fifth breakdown of the indicator: "Details" or "Actions". Missing where the record has no fifth breakdown.

dim5type_seq

Sort order number of the type of the fifth breakdown.

dimension5_value

Code of the category of the fifth breakdown that the record refers to, for example "SUFFIC".

dimension5_value_name

Name of the category of the fifth breakdown that the record refers to, for example "Sufficiency".

dim5val_seq

Sort order number of the category of the fifth breakdown.

dimension6_type

Code of the sixth breakdown of the indicator. It holds "DETAIL" in 345 rows and is missing in all others.

dimension6_type_name

Name of the sixth breakdown of the indicator. It holds "Details" in 345 rows and is missing in all others.

dim6type_seq

Sort order number of the type of the sixth breakdown. It holds 7 in 345 rows and is missing in all others.

dimension6_value

Code of the category of the sixth breakdown. It holds "REQTS" in 345 rows and is missing in all others.

dimension6_value_name

Name of the category of the sixth breakdown. It holds "Requirements" in 345 rows and is missing in all others.

dim6val_seq

Sort order number of the category of the sixth breakdown. It holds 83 in 345 rows and is missing in all others.

value_code_numeric

The value as a number (source column ValCodeNum). For records of data type "Decimal" it is the reported number. For records of data type "Text" it is a number given to the answer, for example 1 for "Yes" and 0 for "No", and it is missing for "No response" and "Not applicable".

value_code

Code of the answer for records of data type "Text", for example "YES", "NO" or "NR" for no response. Missing for records of data type "Decimal".

value_amount

The reported number for records of data type "Decimal", rounded to two decimal places, in the unit named in unit_of_measure. Missing for records of data type "Text".

value_text

The value as text: the wording of the answer for records of data type "Text", and the number written as text for records of data type "Decimal".

val_seq

Sort order number of the answer within the indicator. "No response" has the number 9 or 11. Missing for records of data type "Decimal".

data_type

Type of the value: "Text" for an answer from a list of answers, "Decimal" for a number.

unit_of_measure

Unit of the number in value_amount: "%", "US$" or "US$ millions". Missing for records of data type "Text" and for numbers without a unit, such as counts and years.

hex_color

Hex colour code given to the answer in the WHO source table, for example "#F68620". Missing for records of data type "Decimal" and for 29 records of data type "Text".

country_highlights

Country highlights field of the WHO source table. Empty in every row.

survey_round

Survey field of the WHO source table. Empty in every row.

comment1_type

Code for the kind of extra information in comment1, for example "BASE_YEAR", "FINANCIAL_YEAR" or "DESC". Missing where the record has no first comment.

comment1_type_name

Name of the kind of extra information in comment1, for example "Baseline year", "Financial year" or "Description".

comment1

First piece of extra information that the country gave with the value, stored as text in the language of the answer, for example a year, a description or the name of a ministry.

comment2_type

Code for the kind of extra information in comment2, for example "YRAPPROVE", "TARGET_YEAR" or "POPULATION". Missing where the record has no second comment.

comment2_type_name

Name of the kind of extra information in comment2, for example "Year approved", "Target year" or "Population (000s)". Missing for some codes.

comment2

Second piece of extra information that goes with the value, stored as text, for example a year, a population figure or a reference.

comment3_type

Code for the kind of extra information in comment3, for example "POLICY", "COST", "YEAR" or "GDP". Missing where the record has no third comment.

comment3_type_name

Name of the kind of extra information in comment3, for example "Policy", "Cost", "Year" or "Gross domestic product (millions)". Missing for some codes.

comment3

Third piece of extra information that goes with the value, stored as text, for example the name of a policy, a cost or a year.

record_id

Unique identifier of the record in the WHO source table. It holds the same value as sys_id.

sys_primary_key

Unique whole number key of the row in the WHO xMart database.

sys_row_title

Row title field of the WHO xMart database. Every row holds "-".

sys_version

Version number of the record in the WHO xMart database: 1, 2 or 3.

sys_version_id

Identifier of the record version: the record identifier in capital letters, a dot and the version number.

sys_origin_code

Code of the process that wrote the record to the WHO xMart database: "SYS_DATA_LOAD" or "PIPE_PUBLISH_CH".

sys_loaded_by

Field of the WHO xMart database for who loaded the record. Every row holds "-".

sys_commit_date

Date and time in UTC when the current version of the record was written to the WHO xMart database, between 20 and 23 July 2026.

sys_first_loaded_by

Field of the WHO xMart database for who first loaded the record. Every row holds "-".

sys_first_commit_date

Date and time in UTC when the record was first written to the WHO xMart database, between 20 and 23 July 2026.

sys_id

Unique identifier of the record in the WHO xMart database. It holds the same value as record_id.

sys_batch_id

Number of the load batch that wrote the current version of the record to the WHO xMart database.

sys_first_batch_id

Number of the load batch that first wrote the record to the WHO xMart database.

Source

https://glaas.who.int/
